(b) Ascribed real-to-complex terms (1 - t/a : ℂ) elaborate with DISTRIBUTED casts (1 - (t:ℂ)/(a:ℂ)), never as a single Complex.ofReal; therefore RCLike.norm_ofReal's pattern ‖↑r‖ = |r| does NOT match ‖1 - (t:ℂ)/a‖ directly - bridge with have hof : (1 - (t:ℂ)/a : ℂ) = Complex.ofReal (1 - t/a) := by simp and then rw [hof, RCLike.norm_ofReal r]. (c) field_simp's normalization rewrites ‖c - z‖ to ‖-z + c‖ (via norm_sub + add-comm simp lemmas) - uniform norm rewrites are safe only after first rw [norm_sub_rev z c] to homogenize both sides. (e) Finset.induction_on over a concrete term (induction hfin.toFinset) does NOT rewrite local hypotheses introduced before the induction that mention that term - factor the statement as a lemma over a Finset variable (hsumCont) so the induction hypothesis applies to insert i s directly. (g) The meromorphic bridge's namespace: MeromorphicAt.eventuallyEq_nhdsNE_of_eventuallyEq_codiscreteWithin (it lives in the MeromorphicAt namespace, not top-level).
